planets.name: HD 152843 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 152843 with a 19.5-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: HD 152843 c was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 152843. Its orbit and size follow Nicholson et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
